note: openworld/PLAN-SITES.md section 2. A site is one settlement of the scale model (its id in tools/scale-model/model/src/60-settlements.js, on the 5.1 canvas) and its hinterland; a region is the cut that holds one or more sites (tools/scale-model/cut_site.py <region>). reach_km is the half-size of a site's square (city 30, village 15, outpost or camp 8 by default); polygons are regions of the model (by id) that join the cut; corridors are strips width_km wide between two of the region's sites (so the roads between them have ground). state: planned | cut | built.
